summary: Verified and FIXED the mobile footer disclaimer overlap bug. The Learn more link now has sufficient gap (>=8px) to the bottom bar on all mobile widths (320px, 390px, 430px). Applied fixes to EnterpriseAIDisclaimer.tsx (paddingBottom: 24, marginTop: 6) and Footer.tsx (marginBottom: 44).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Footer disclaimer overlap bug is now FIXED. All mobile widths (320px, 390px, 430px) pass the contract: learnGap >= 8px and shellGap >= 0. Non-regression tests also passed: address row visible, section titles centered, Learn more link clickable, no horizontal overflow, modal opens on Learn more click.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The Learn more link inside EnterpriseAIDisclaimer had marginTop: 10px which pushed it outside the container's bounds. The container's paddingBottom (16px) was insufficient to contain the Learn more link (24px height). Combined with the footer-disclaimer-shell's marginBottom (36px), the total gap was less than the Learn more link's overflow.
reproduction_steps: 2. Set viewport to mobile width (320px, 390px, or 430px)
4. Observe Learn more link overlapping with copyright row
fix_applied: EnterpriseAIDisclaimer.tsx: Changed paddingBottom from 16px to 24px for compact mobile
EnterpriseAIDisclaimer.tsx: Changed marginTop from 10px to 6px for Learn more link on compact mobile
Footer.tsx: Changed marginBottom of footer-disclaimer-shell from 36px to 44px for compact mobile
